name: Electric Latch Rune
disable: DC 20 Thievery check (expert) to scratch out the rune without allowing electricity to flow, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to counteract the rune

items.name: Electrocution
items.text:
Trigger A creature grasps the door latch directly or with a tool

---

Effect The trap deals 3d12 electricity damage to the triggering creature (DC 22 basic Reflex save save).

text: An invisible rune imprinted on a door latch releases a powerful electric discharge.
